scope: Published named visitor places and interpretive walks; no surveyed parking entrances, directions, access approval or routing geometry

ottawa.intro: At Ottawa, step back to see the full eight-lock staircase, then get closer to understand what the lock staff are doing.

places.name: Plaza Bridge overlook
places.watch: Look north over the historic lock flight toward the Ottawa River. The changing height of each chamber is easier to understand from above.
places.approach: Reach the public bridge by city sidewalks; this is an overlook, not a lockstation entrance or parking location.

places.name: Canal-level public walk
places.watch: From the public paths by the canal, watch staff work the gates and the boats change levels during the navigation season.
places.approach: Ottawa Tourism suggests descending from the bridge toward canal level. The exact accessible approach and current access must be confirmed on site.
places.googleQuery: Bytown Museum Rideau Canal Locks Ottawa Ontario Canada

ottawa.foodText: Find a cafe nearby on the city map. Results are third-party listings, not personally verified dining recommendations.

jones-falls.intro: Jones Falls rewards a little walking: you can compare the lock flight with the massive stone dam that made this crossing possible.

places.name: Redpath Trail loop
places.watch: Follow the site's story from the long bridge past the flight locks, visitor centre, Sweeney House and Stone Arch Dam.
places.approach: Parks Canada describes an approximately 1 km loop starting and ending at the main parking area. The published trail is not a verified GPS walking track.
places.googleQuery: Jones Falls Lockstation 182 Lock Road Rideau Lakes Ontario Canada

places.name: Stone Arch Dam viewing platform
places.watch: At the western end of the Stone Arch Dam, an interpretive panel and viewing platform help explain the scale of the stonework.
places.approach: Reach it as part of Parks Canada's Jones Falls walking tour. Check the official site for closures or restrictions before setting out.
places.googleQuery: Jones Falls Stone Arch Dam Rideau Lakes Ontario Canada

jones-falls.foodText: Search for nearby food before leaving: rural businesses may be spread out, and this guide does not verify their opening hours.
